subtopic: Trump Account Rules Before and After Age 18
source_evidence: The account is held in the child’s name, with a parent or guardian serving as custodian until the child reaches age 18. After the child turns 18, most of the special rules no longer apply and traditional IRA rules generally apply.
answer: Before age 18, a Trump Account is held in the child’s name and a parent or guardian serves as its custodian. Once the child turns 18, most of the account’s special rules no longer apply, and traditional IRA rules generally apply.
